name: We're Getting Deeper Into The Abyss
detailed_description:
We're Getting Deeper Into The Abyss is a story-based game that focuses on the main character Frei Kay, an artist who creates through inspiration throughout the world around him. Sometimes, he tends to space out and the world changes around him. Creating what he calls in his journal the Abyss.

Follow along the story while you, the player can explore these special Abyss areas, these tell stories about who Frei Kay really is and what he tends to experience on a personal level.

Frei, an inspiring musical artist. Who tends to think about the little things a bit too much. Others consider him a gentle soul and quiet, while he would consider himself talkative. Yet, He'd describe himself as timid, though people see him always throwing himself into situations to please others if they are distressed, even if it stresses himself out. Being a well-known fellow around town, his goal was always to spread his musical voice. 

What's The Features?

  • A rich story, with a unique world to explore. Multiple side stories with an opportunity to learn more about the world, and several different characters around you. All with different personalities. Take a break from the story and play a select few mini games around the town. Learn about the town you're in, go to the library and read some stuff, they may bring Frei into a creative state of mind!

  • A day and night system. Some side-objectives and characters can appear in the day or night. While this is frustrating in some other games, the day and night system is designed to be unique, fair, and overall, a different experience than others. Time skipping will be available and real-time. If the player has beaten every side-objective in the day, they can skip right to night by time-skipping.

    NOTE: To learn more about this mechanic in detail, read into DEVLOG #13 - A List Of Future Mechanics!

  • Different art-styles are going to be presented in the game, such as in the Abyss, mini-games, and in the main area where Frei will journey through, the Town of Heaven, previously known as the Village of Rapture.

  • The world is meant to be explored, as you'll experience multiple emotions here. Comedic, fear, disgust, it goes on! The world is full of lovely things to do other than just the story.

  • The guitar Frei Kay carries guides you; players will earn multiple things throughout the game that will make playing more enjoyable. Such as higher jumping, running faster, getting onto higher things, y'know, fun stuff like that. Music is a powerful thing!

 So much more!

Join The Discord! Follow Development!

DEV NOTE:

This is a passion project, the game has been in mind since 2017, just starting in 2023. Updates are going to go to the Steam Page/Discord. The art here is NOT final, these are all placeholders. Expect better art. Most likely, these screenshots here are already outdated. I HIGHLY recommend taking a look at the DEVLOGs posted in the News Tab on Steam. 

Minimum System Requirements are speculated for now, but I'd say maximum could be wrong, I am using a 3060 and 5600x, and the game is over 140fps in all resolutions. Early development though. The game is being developed in 1080p, I'll be testing in all resolutions (1080, 2k, 4k.) I do not test in 8k, but if someone requests that they'd like me to optimize for 8k, I will absolutely dedicate my time for you. Let me know. Even Steam Deck testing. Further testing will be done down the line. 

This game is actively in development and will take some time. This is being developed by a single fellow! Check out the Discord if you have any big questions or requests. Thank you!

short_description: Follow the story of "Frei K", an artist who is searching for answers about his eventful past, yet he is someone that is starved for love, putting others ahead of himself first. Experience unique multiple areas, side-stories, collectables, mini-games, and different endings.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core I5-8400 / Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 1060Ti / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Game is currently in early development, specs are heavily estimated. MIN requirements will be tested further down the line, my goal is to release this without performance or stuttering hits on a 1080p monitor with a 60fps cap limit. Once again, ESTIMATED GUESS. This will be tested down the line.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core I7-8700K / Ryzen 5 5600x
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 or Higher / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: The game is currently in early development; specs are heavily estimated. MAX requirements are what the game is being developed on. No issues are present when it comes to performance when played on 1080p, 2k, and 4k. Reaching at least or over 140fps each time
